title: Wat Pa Tam Wua — round 2 suggestions
notes: Applied: photo cuts + chanting starts after the English bit. Below are structural / rewrite suggestions for the note-y parts — approve, reject, or leave feedback and I'll implement next.

proposals.before: The five hindrances listed as bullets (sense pleasures, ill-will, sloth, restlessness, sceptical doubt) + the 'only way beyond doubt' line.
proposals.after: Drop the whole block. It reads like course notes and isn't tied to anything you personally noticed at the monastery.
proposals.rationale: Highest 'notes dump' smell in the Buddhism section. The Four Noble Truths + three characteristics carry the idea; this doesn't earn its space.

proposals.summary: Cut or collapse the Noble Eightfold Path bullets
proposals.before: Three bullets grouping the eight folds under Wisdom / Morality / Concentration.
proposals.after:
Option A: one sentence — 'The path out is the Noble Eightfold Path (right view, speech, action, … — basically wisdom, ethics, and meditation practice).'
Option B: keep as-is.
proposals.rationale: Same notes vibe. Magga is already named in the Four Noble Truths; expanding it is encyclopedic unless you have a personal take.

proposals.summary: Merge the two 'questions to monks' paragraphs
proposals.before: Separate paras about asking the Abbot, then asking after Dharma talks — both end at 'figure it out yourself / practice more'.
proposals.after: One tighter paragraph, e.g.: 'I asked a bunch of questions after Dharma talks and to the Abbot. None of the answers were very concrete — it's years of practice, and your own body and mind are the teacher. Annoying at first if you want explanations, but that is kind of the point.'
proposals.rationale: Currently says the same thing twice. One version keeps the frustration without the repetition.

proposals.summary: Turn Knower vs Thinker bullets into 2–3 prose sentences
proposals.before: Four bullets under 'Knower vs Thinker mind'.
proposals.after: Fold into the walking-meditation paragraph or a short follow-on: you can't be knower and thinker at once; watching the mind knowing the breath is the move; you can't force the knower to appear.
proposals.rationale: Bullets feel like flashcards mid-essay. Your voice is stronger in paragraphs.

proposals.before: Long how-to covering deep breaths → nose point → distractions → visuals → jhana twice.
proposals.after: Keep the personal results (absorption nights, body-deforming scare). Compress technique to ~3 sentences, or move the how-to into a short footnote-style aside.
proposals.rationale: It's useful but denser than the rest of the post and overlaps with what you already said about Samatha.

proposals.summary: Promote Stoicism to its own h3 — or cut it
proposals.before: Inline 'Stoicism vs Buddhism, briefly:' with two long bullets.
proposals.after:
Option A: h3 'Stoicism vs Buddhism' + keep the two contrasts.
Option B: cut entirely — it's a side tangent that arrives late and isn't grounded in the monastery week.
Option C: one sentence in Takeaways: 'Closest Western cousin I've found is Stoicism — reframe judgments vs watch feelings pass.'
proposals.rationale: You flagged this area as notes. I'd lean Option C unless you want the fuller comparison.

proposals.summary: Drop or shrink the Why Buddhism Is True paragraph
proposals.after:
Option A: cut — you didn't list Wright in the Kindle books you actually read at the monastery.
Option B: keep one sentence if you're reading it now ('started Wright after — modular mind / no CEO-self').
proposals.rationale: It's the one place that still feels like a TODO from the original draft ('scientific side…'). Your real reading list is now at the bottom.

proposals.summary: Tighten the London checklist into themes
proposals.after:
Group into 4 lines, e.g.:
• Inputs: less phone/laptop; pickier about podcasts/YT/news
• Practice: sitting + walking meditation; yoga/sports/hot-cold
• Food: earlier meals / occasional fasts
• Life: deep daily project, reading/writing, loving-kindness, community
(Keep journal re-read as its own line if you want.)
proposals.rationale: You rejected a hard cut before; grouping keeps the content but reads less like a personal TODO dump.

proposals.summary: Reorder: Meditation experiences before Buddhism textbook
proposals.before: Monastery life → Meditation (mixed how-to + experience) → Buddhism survey → Takeaways.
proposals.after: Monastery life → Meditation experiences (walking, evenings, absorption, body scare) → lighter Buddhism (only what you needed to make sense of it) → Takeaways + books.
proposals.rationale: Your personal arc is the interesting part. The Four Noble Truths block currently breaks the spell after the best stories.

proposals.summary: Remove duplicate Walk to be the Knower plug
proposals.before: Quoted + linked in the walking section, then plugged again before the gym-for-the-mind line.
proposals.after: Keep the quote + links once. Drop the later 'The monastery published…' paragraph (or keep the gym metaphor and lose only the book sentence).
proposals.rationale: Same book, same dual links, twice.

proposals.before: Long first paragraph: no experience → amazing → base state → Little Book of Clarity → recommend everyone.
proposals.after: Two shorter paras: (1) where/how long + no prior experience + how it felt. (2) Clarity = Capacity − Contamination + recommendation.
proposals.rationale: Opening is good but one long block. Split = easier skim without changing voice.

proposals.before: Shanghai paragraph jumps to bath houses / Taobao as 'opposite of Buddhism'.
proposals.after: Keep the contrast but one beat less list-y — e.g. one concrete image (24h bath house) + 'consumerism at full volume' instead of stacking examples.
proposals.rationale: Funny and true; slightly baggy. Easy reject if you like the energy.
